research_alignment.comparison_rule: Three same-city alternatives selected by visible laser/service overlap, not by ratings or size. Amy laser hair removal is a research hypothesis, not an approved priority. Confirm current Lannion services before freezing queries. Material changes to treatment market or competitor set require a revised alignment.

queries.selection: Use publicly confirmed current Lannion services, location and client booking intent; include procedure/area and price/consultation/booking modifiers only where relevant. No service transferred from an unresolved old listing.
queries.freeze_timing: First full-research block after alignment approval
queries.frequency_provenance: Record source, geography, period and method for any volume claim. Without reproducible permitted data use candidate_query with frequency null; autocomplete or model wording is not measured frequency.

social.sample: Up to 20 most recent eligible posts per verified account in the common window; profile and pinned content separately dated. Read available captions, video descriptions/transcripts, user comments and practice replies with actual per-type counts and access limits.
social.ownership: Official cross-link or matching public identifiers; similar name alone insufficient.

reviews.qualitative_sample: Up to 30 most recent dated reviews in the window per business/platform, plus visible owner responses; disclose actual counts.
reviews.velocity: Only when the dated 90-day source is complete; otherwise insufficient_evidence.
reviews.comparability: Do not pool platforms or locations; historical/out-of-window material is labelled context; repeated themes require at least two independent eligible observations.

method.search_maps: Branded identity and approved local treatment query family, matching geography/time/method; no geo-grid rank inference from ordinary web search.
method.public_paths: Same service-choice task, mobile-first plus desktop cross-check, entry to visible enquiry/booking boundary; follow up to 2-3 public transitions where available. No form submission, call, DM or appointment.
method.evidence: Source URL, subject/location, date, method/window, classification, limitations and reviewer status retained; no scores from missing access.
